title: Ethiopian-Style Atakilt Wat with Burdock and Gobo
description: A flavorful and nutritious Ethiopian-inspired dish made with a variety of vegetables, including burdock and gobo. This recipe combines the traditional atakilt wat with a unique twist using these lesser-known ingredients.
instructions: Peel and chop the gobo and burdock into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the extraordinary oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, tumeric, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped gobo and burdock to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot over injera or with some crusty bread.
